versions.changelog:
KrumpPhysio 1.0.11 adds new privacy and AI features for Telegram video bot users.

- Telegram bot now immediately replies to users and supports `/start` with onboarding prompts.
- Adds optional zero-knowledge attestation (Sindri) and privacy headers for minimal-PII workflows.
- Supports `/privacy` and optional auto-deletion of user videos after analysis.
- Integrates Kimi + Replicate: generate exercise images/videos and send back AI captions/descriptions.
- Other documentation updates for privacy, bot commands, and user experience.

No changes detected in this version.

- No file changes or updates were made for version 1.0.10.
- Functionality, features, and documentation remain the same as the previous release.

No functional changes. Documentation update only:

- Clarified Telegram bot voice features: now requires `ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID` to be set to a valid ElevenLabs voice for TTS and added error note for missing/invalid IDs.
- No code or logic changes; all behavior remains the same.

krumpphysio 1.0.8

- Adds a deployer note clarifying that MEMORY.md must not include false "clinical lockout" or "NHS regulation" data, or the agent may refuse to perform movement scoring.
- No code or functionality changes; documentation update only.

KrumpPhysio 1.0.7

- Clarified that duplicate and repeated movement scoring requests are always allowed—there are no bans, lockouts, or refusals based on repetition or "regulations".
- Updated documentation to explicitly instruct the agent to always provide a score and feedback for each scoring request.

KrumpPhysio 1.0.6 adds new accessibility and multimedia features for the Telegram video analysis bot.

- Added optional ElevenLabs TTS/STT support in the video sidecar bot: can reply with voice, transcribe user voice notes, and (if enabled) send a short instrumental beat after each analysis.
- No core logic or interface changes; SKILL.md updated to document these new Telegram bot options under video-based analysis.
- Maintains full backward compatibility—feature is optional and gracefully falls back to text-only if not configured.

KrumpPhysio v1.0.5 changelog:

- Added support for video-based pose analysis: agents can now analyse uploaded video clips for joint movement, generate movement scoring, and reply with detailed feedback in KrumpPhysio style.
- Documented Telegram video sidecar bot integration for automated video analysis and OpenClaw metrics forwarding.
- No code changes; all updates are in usage guidelines and skill documentation.

KrumpPhysio 1.0.4

- Updated quantum-inspired weekly plan instructions: use the Python script in a virtual environment (venv) for reliable Guppylang/Selene execution, and reply with concise coaching, not raw JSON.
- Added best practice notes for agent selection (make default in `agents.list`) and for producing comprehensive, multi-part replies after exec.
- Improved reply guidelines for quantum workout plans: include a practical tip for the focus area and health advice with “Krump for life!” sign-off.
- Linked to new BEST-PRACTICES.md for deployment and operational guidance.
- Documentation clarifies exec paths and agent ordering for OpenClaw Chat and Telegram support.

KrumpPhysio v1.0.3 adds quantum-inspired exercise optimisation.

- Added support for quantum-inspired and quantum-optimised exercise scheduling using Guppy + Selene integration.
- Updated usage guidelines to cover quantum schedule requests (with exec path and required dependencies).
- No code changes detected; SKILL.md documentation only.

KrumpPhysio 1.0.2 changelog:

- Added guidance for Stripe-based monetization, including session payment link creation via exec with provided Node script.
- Clarified that the Anyway plugin provides observability only; does not process payments.
- Expanded documentation with Stripe integration references and detailed payment workflow instructions.
- No functional changes to agent behavior or movement scoring flows.

KrumpPhysio 1.0.1 — Adds observability instructions using Anyway+OpenClaw

- Added detailed setup guide for observing/monitoring KrumpPhysio agent activity via the Anyway OpenClaw plugin (tracing, tool IO).
- Expanded documentation with configuration examples for Anyway plugin in OpenClaw, including key options and environment variable support.
- No changes to core coaching, scoring, or logging behavior.

KrumpPhysio 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a skill for teaching OpenClaw agents to coach physiotherapy using adapted Krump vocabulary and Laban notation.
- Supports scoring of therapeutic movement (joint angles, ROM) with feedback and gamified Krump "battle round" framing.
- Enables rehab session logging to a Canton ledger (optional, if configured).
- Provides guidance for authentic krump adaptations if other skills are available.
- Designed for use in SDG 3-aligned health/rehab flows and fitness agent assistance.
